title: Creed Digital Launches New AI Search Strategies, Helping Businesses Evolve Alongside the Changing Digital Landscape - TMX Newsfile
description: Creed Digital Launches New AI Search Strategies, Helping Businesses Evolve Alongside the Changing Digital Landscape TMX Newsfile
bottomLine: Creed Digital launches AI-powered search strategies to help businesses adapt to digital change, signaling rising competitive pressure on discovery and research tools.
keyFindings: Creed Digital has introduced new AI search strategies designed to help organizations navigate evolving digital landscapes.
The announcement emphasizes AI-assisted search as a differentiator for business adaptation and decision-making.
Positioning suggests growing market demand for intelligent search and discovery solutions beyond traditional platforms.
The move reflects broader industry trend of embedding AI into research and information discovery workflows.
whyItMatters: Belgian research institutions and universities are evaluating AI-enhanced discovery tools; Elsevier must demonstrate how LeapSpace's integrated AI (literature search, author discovery, writing coach) outperforms point solutions like Creed Digital's offering in speed, accuracy, and institutional ROI.
actionItems: Request full product details from Creed Digital to assess specific AI capabilities, accuracy metrics, and target customer segments in Belgium.
Prepare competitive comparison of LeapSpace AI features (literature search, claim-checking, deep reports) versus Creed Digital for sales conversations.
Identify which Belgian institutions may be Creed Digital prospects and prioritize outreach to demonstrate LeapSpace's integrated advantage.

title: Introducing ChatGPT for Teens: Built for learning, backed by protections - OpenAI
description: Introducing ChatGPT for Teens: Built for learning, backed by protections  OpenAI
bottomLine: OpenAI launches ChatGPT for Teens with safety guardrails, positioning generalist AI as a learning tool for younger researchers and students.
keyFindings: ChatGPT for Teens is a new product variant with age-appropriate protections and features designed specifically for educational use.
The tool includes built-in safety measures and content filtering to protect minors while enabling learning and research assistance.
OpenAI frames this as backing institutional learning, directly competing for adoption in school and university environments.
whyItMatters: Belgian universities and secondary institutions now face pressure to adopt or regulate free generalist AI tools. Elsevier must emphasize how curated, discipline-specific tools like LeapSpace offer institutional control, citation integrity, and research quality that ChatGPT lacks.
actionItems: Map adoption of ChatGPT for Teens across target Belgian institutions and identify institutional concerns about AI governance in research.
Develop messaging positioning LeapSpace as the research-grade alternative with institutional control, verified sources, and compliance.

title: Local AI Registry Launches First Public Registry of AI Business Recommendations - TMX Newsfile
description: Local AI Registry Launches First Public Registry of AI Business Recommendations  TMX Newsfile
bottomLine: First public registry of AI business recommendations launches, signaling fragmentation and competition in AI recommendation and discovery ecosystems.
keyFindings: Local AI Registry debuts as a public directory of AI business tools and recommendations, aiming to help organizations discover relevant AI solutions.
The registry addresses the growing fragmentation of AI tool discovery, competing with aggregators and platforms that help match needs to solutions.
This reflects rising demand for AI tool curation and recommendation, suggesting organizations struggle to navigate the crowded AI landscape.
whyItMatters: Belgian research institutions are increasingly confused about which AI and discovery tools to adopt. Elsevier should position Scopus and LeapSpace as unified, vetted alternatives to fragmented registries, emphasizing expertise curation and research-specific intelligence over generic AI marketplace discovery.
actionItems: Monitor Local AI Registry adoption and coverage of competing research discovery tools (Dimensions, OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar) to track positioning.
Clarify to prospects how Scopus and LeapSpace integrate research discovery, AI assistance, and institutional governance in one platform versus fragmented registries.
